validation.rule: 10% of the training-fold samples per flow, all three half lengths of a sample together; used only for epoch selection

neighbors.rule: 64 nearest samples of the same flow (KD-tree on seeds, every fold); FPS from the center; k=6 uses the first six of the FPS16 order

rows: one row per (sample, half length); neighbour lines use the same half length as the center line
device: local RTX 3090 (deterministic flags of the frozen engine; V100-only guard of the p35 nearest-neighbour encoding lifted because the cluster is selected here in float64 and the encoder receives exactly k neighbours)
fixed_features: 23 center + 72 direction + 23 neighbour mean + 23 numerical max = 141
comparison: p35/h0 and c156 with FPS6 and FPS16 clusters, three seeds each, on the audited Task4-c fixed dataset v2 (fold 0 test); reported combined, per flow, per half length and per GT instance
